run_metadata.coverage_summary: WebSearch-only discovery run. External WebFetch/egress remained fully blocked by the environment proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED) this run too — reconfirmed against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au — even though the proxy status endpoint reports healthy (enabled:true, bundleCoversEveryHost:true, recentRelayFailures empty), i.e. an organisation-level egress policy rather than a transient fault. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened; every opportunity is captured at headline level only. Detail is drawn solely from WebSearch result link titles (which carry the target page's own <title>, e.g. 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender' or '<title> - <RFT ID> | buy.nsw', treated as reliable for existence/status/ID) plus WebSearch answer snippets (treated as unverified for exact dates/scope and flagged in notes). Tier 1 Commonwealth (AusTender) and all eight state/territory portals (NSW buy.nsw, VIC Buying for Victoria/tenders.vic.gov.au, QLD QTenders, WA Tenders WA, SA Tenders SA/contracts.sa.gov.au, TAS Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) were probed via search. AusTender surfaced eight verifiable Current-ATM link titles NOT present in the routine's 492 known dedup keys (13016, 13457, RFT 02-2026, RFT 04-2026, CD/RFT/27857/1, RFT Tranches 1-4, RFT-12493, DFAT-IMD-RFT-IWSS) — captured at headline level; titles/buyers/dates are not in the link text (except DFAT inferable from the DFAT- prefix) and remain null pending an unblocked detail pass. buy.nsw surfaced one verifiable NEW individual opportunity link title (RFT-2007161 Flood Levee Repair Program – Kempsey Shire Council – Detailed Design and REF Package); a related Snowy Monaro item (CAN-RFT-2012658) sat under buy.nsw /notices/ with a CAN- prefix (contract award/cancellation notice, not an open ATM) and was NOT captured. Other verifiable buy.nsw link titles returned (the four Destination NSW / Vivid Sydney opportunities RFT-2011237, RFQ-2010692, RFT-2012417, RFT-2005682) were already-known dedup keys, as were AusTender items ASCA-RFT-2026-LDTPM, PR10031930-RASS, ATM_2026_6786, ATM_2026_3858, 10018162, RFT13109, RFI/2026/ASCQ. Snippet-only NSW items (Vivid 'Site Management Services' closing 29-Sep, Fire System Maintenance Northern/Coffs Tunnels closing 20-Oct, several NSW Public Works levee repair packages for Grafton/Ulmarra/Maclean) appeared only in answer prose without a verifiable individual link title and were deferred, not captured. WA/SA/TAS/NT/ACT/QLD returned only portal landing/search pages or aggregator results with no verifiable individual buyer link title (SA had a scheduled outage 17-Sep-2026; TAS snippet mentioned Derby Master Plan and Derwent Ferry terminals closing Oct; NT QTOL detail pages carry no ID/title in link text) — all headline prose only, not captured. Tier 2 (VendorPanel councils, universities/TAFEs, GBE utilities) sampled: Sydney Water (own current-tenders page + NSW eTendering subsite), Melbourne Water (Buying for Victoria), and university EOIs (UTS Connected Assessment closing 18-Sep, University of Adelaide Poultry Roof Replacement closing 21-Sep, USYD Campus Master Plan EOIs) surfaced only via aggregators (australiantenders.com.au) or a university-hosted tenderlink portal without a buyer-originated verifiable link title and were NOT captured. Tier 3 attempted per mandate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP GCMS/Local Buying Program, Woolworths Partner Hub, Coles-via-Ariba): all corporate opportunity detail is registration- or invitation-gated and none was publicly visible via search, so corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources only, never fabricated as tenders. Source-discovery pass ran: every candidate buyer page found (Sydney Water, Melbourne Water, Logan City Council VendorPanel, NSW Public Works, suppliers.tenders.gov.au) was already among the routine's 341 known sources; novel domains encountered (bidsfactory.com, tendersinfo.com, australiatenders.com, tenderimpulse.com, tendersgo.com/gtbc.net, australiatenderalerts.com, consolidatedtenders.com, tenders.net, tenderhub.com.au, tastenders.com) are third-party aggregators/scrapers excluded by the buyer-originated rule. No genuinely NEW buyer-originated source surfaced this run.
gaps: WebFetch/egress fully blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for ALL external hosts this run — reconfirmed against www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au. No tender detail page or specification document could be opened; all nine captured tenders are headline-level only and require an authenticated/unblocked run for titles (where not in the link text), buyers, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, dates, documents and contacts.

AusTender headline-only items (13016, 13457, RFT 02-2026, RFT 04-2026, CD/RFT/27857/1, RFT Tranches 1-4, RFT-12493): only the 'Current ATM View - <ID>: AusTender' link title and the unique detail-page GUID are verifiable. Title, buyer, category, dates, value and scope are all egress-blocked and recorded null/blank — not guessed. The generic IDs (e.g. 'RFT 02-2026', 'RFT Tranches 1-4') are ambiguous across agencies; the GUID tender_url is the reliable identifier.

AusTender DFAT-IMD-RFT-IWSS: Current-ATM link title verifiable; buyer inferred as DFAT (Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade) from the 'DFAT-' ID prefix only. Title, dates, scope, value egress-blocked and null.

buy.nsw RFT-2007161 (Flood Levee Repair Program – Kempsey Shire Council – Detailed Design and REF Package): title and RFT ID are verifiable from the buy.nsw opportunity link title; buyer recorded as NSW Public Works (the Flood Levee Repair Program is a NSW Public Works program, corroborated by publicworks.nsw.gov.au) with Kempsey Shire Council named in the title as the site/beneficiary. Closing date, value, scope, evaluation criteria and contacts are egress-blocked and null.

buy.nsw CAN-RFT-2012658 (Flood Levee Repair Program ERF Phase 2 Construction, Snowy Monaro Regional Council): verifiable link title but sits under buy.nsw /notices/ with a 'CAN-' prefix (contract award / cancellation notice, not an open ATM); NOT captured as an open tender to avoid mischaracterising it.

Snippet-only NSW opportunities not captured (no verifiable individual link title): Vivid Sydney 'Site Management Services' RFT (reportedly closing 29-Sep-2026), Fire System Maintenance – Northern & Coffs Harbour Tunnels (closing ~20-Oct-2026), and NSW Public Works levee-repair packages for the Grafton area / Ulmarra / Maclean. Defer to an unblocked run.

State/territory portals WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT, QLD: only landing/search pages or aggregator results returned; no verifiable individual buyer link title surfaced. SA Tenders had a scheduled maintenance outage on 17-Sep-2026. TAS (Derby Master Plan consultancy closing 01-Oct, Derwent Ferry terminals closing 15-Oct) and NT QTOL items appeared only as answer prose / ID-less detail links and were deferred, not captured.

Tier 2 universities/TAFEs, GBE utilities and public health: UTS Connected Assessment Ecosystem EOI (closing 18-Sep), University of Adelaide Poultry Roof Replacement (closing 21-Sep), USYD Campus Master Plan EOIs, Sydney Water 'Strategic Customer Engagement 2026-2029' market sounding and Melbourne Water opportunities surfaced only via aggregators or a university-hosted tenderlink portal without a buyer-originated verifiable link title; not captured. Full portal sweep deferred pending unblocked WebFetch.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network Discovery/Ariba, BHP GCMS/Local Buying Program, Woolworths Partner Hub, Coles-via-Ariba): opportunity detail is registration-/invitation-gated and none publicly visible via search; portals recorded in discovered_sources only, no corporate tender fabricated. Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. consultancy RFPs to shortlisted panels) remain out of scope and undiscoverable.

No genuinely new buyer-originated source found this run; all candidate buyer pages surfaced were already among the 341 known sources, and novel domains encountered were aggregators/scrapers excluded by policy.
recommended_seed_additions: Commonwealth Supplier Portal (suppliers.tenders.gov.au) — federal reverse-marketplace supplement to AusTender; a searchable supplier database rather than a tender board. Already tracked; worth a periodic check for the point at which buyer-posted sourcing/discovery events become publicly visible.

tenders.title: Flood Levee Repair Program – Kempsey Shire Council – Detailed Design and REF Package
tenders.description: buy.nsw open Request for Tender for detailed design and a Review of Environmental Factors (REF) package under the NSW Public Works Flood Levee Repair Program, for levee sites associated with Kempsey Shire Council. Captured at headline level from the verifiable buy.nsw opportunity link title only.

Buyer-originated (buy.nsw is the NSW Government's chosen publication channel).

Closing date, value, scope, evaluation criteria and contacts require verification on an unblocked run.
